description: NFL coaching staffs as of February 2026, i.e. after every completed hire of the 2026 hiring cycle (10 head-coach changes: ARI, ATL, BAL, BUF, CLE, LV, MIA, NYG, PIT, TEN). Head coach / OC / DC names and sinceYear values are taken verbatim from the Wikipedia 'current coordinators/head coaches' list pages and the per-team Template:<Team> staff pages, which are the same source family for all 32 teams. offSchemeGuess and defSchemeGuess are inferences mapped to the closest enum value; the real scheme name and coaching lineage are in notes. Any inferred (non-quoted) claim is marked '(inferred)' or 'LOW CONFIDENCE'.
caveats: Snapshot fetched 2026-07-29; Wikipedia 'current' list pages reflect the July 2026 state. Every sinceYear of 2026 traces to a January/February 2026 hire, and no post-February 2026 staff change was found in the sources, so the file is treated as the February 2026 state.
Tampa Bay has no separate defensive coordinator: HC Todd Bowles has held the DC title since 2019 and calls the defense himself. defensiveCoordinator is null there.

Offensive play-caller assignments are sourced (FantasyIndex team-by-team 2026 ranking). Defensive play-caller assignments for the six defensive head coaches (BAL, MIA, NYJ, SEA, TB, TEN) are derived arithmetically from the published counts (18 offensive HC play-callers, 6 defensive HC play-callers, 8 CEO head coaches: LAC, WAS, PHI, ATL, NYG, DET, NE, HOU) and are marked '(inferred)' in the notes.
Special teams coordinators, assistant/associate head coaches and GMs were captured in the raw sources under _sources/coaches/ but are only surfaced in notes, not as schema fields.

ARI.notes: LaFleur hired Feb 1, 2026 (replaced fired Jonathan Gannon); first HC job, previously Rams OC 2023-25. Real off scheme: Shanahan/McVay outside-zone + play-action; LaFleur calls the plays, Hackett runs the room. Real def scheme: Rallis' Fangio/Gannon-derived two-high nickel. Rallis is the lone coordinator holdover. [scheme] offScheme=Shanahan / defScheme=Multiple are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WideZone / defSchemeGuess=Nickel.

ATL.notes: Stefanski hired Jan 17, 2026 (replaced fired Raheem Morris); Browns HC 2020-25. Real off scheme: Kubiak/Shanahan outside-zone play-action under center. Stefanski does NOT call plays - Rees (his Cleveland play-caller, followed him from CLE) calls them. Real def scheme: Ulbrich's Saleh/Seattle 4-3 with single-high Cover 3. [scheme] offScheme=Shanahan / defScheme=Cover3 are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WideZone / defSchemeGuess=CoverThree.

BAL.notes: Minter hired Jan 22, 2026 after John Harbaugh was fired following 18 seasons; Minter was Chargers DC 2024-25. Full coordinator turnover. Real off scheme: Doyle blends Sean Payton (Saints/Broncos) and Ben Johnson (Bears OC 2025) motion-heavy play-action; Doyle calls plays and is a first-time NFL play-caller. Real def scheme: Ravens/Macdonald-lineage multiple front with heavy pre-snap disguise; Minter is a defensive-HC play-caller (inferred from league-wide 2026 play-caller counts), Weaver runs the unit. [scheme] offScheme=ProPassing / defScheme=Hybrid are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=ProStyle / defSchemeGuess=Hybrid.

BUF.notes: Brady promoted from OC to HC Jan 27, 2026 after Sean McDermott was fired (9 seasons, 98-50); first HC job. Real off scheme: up-tempo 11-personnel spread/quick game; Brady keeps play-calling, Carmichael (Payton/Saints tree, Broncos senior offensive assistant 2024-25) is OC. Real def scheme: Leonhard's Fangio-influenced two-high nickel (Broncos asst HC / def pass game coordinator 2025). [scheme] offScheme=Spread / defScheme=Multiple are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=Spread / defSchemeGuess=Nickel.

CAR.notes: Fully intact staff - no 2026 changes. Real off scheme: Canales' Seattle/Shanahan outside zone plus heavy play-action; Canales calls the plays. Real def scheme: Evero's Fangio-derived 3-4 with two-high shells. [scheme] offScheme=Shanahan / defScheme=Base34 are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WideZone / defSchemeGuess=34.

CHI.notes: Johnson enters year 2 (11-6, NFC North title in 2025). Taylor promoted from passing game coordinator after Declan Doyle left to be Ravens OC. Real off scheme: Johnson's motion-heavy, condensed-set multiple pro-style with a gap-scheme run game; Johnson calls the plays. Real def scheme: Dennis Allen's aggressive 4-3 with man coverage and high pressure rate. [scheme] offScheme=ProPassing / defScheme=PressMan are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=ProStyle / defSchemeGuess=ManPress.

CIN.notes: Longest-tenured staff continuity in the AFC North after the division's other three teams turned over. Real off scheme: McVay-derived 11-personnel spread passing game; Taylor calls the plays, Pitcher is OC. Real def scheme: Golden's multiple 4-3 with zone-match coverage. Darrin Simmons doubles as assistant head coach / special teams coordinator. [scheme] offScheme=Spread / defScheme=Base43 are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=Spread / defSchemeGuess=43.

CLE.notes: Monken hired Jan 28, 2026 after Kevin Stefanski was fired (6 seasons); Monken was Ravens OC 2023-25 and Southern Miss HC 2013-15. Coordinators announced Feb 20, 2026. Real off scheme: Monken's explosive vertical play-action passing game; Monken calls the plays, Switzer (Ravens run game coordinator 2024-25) is OC. Real def scheme: Rutenberg comes from the Saleh/Schwartz wide-9 front (49ers 2020, Jets LBs 2021-24, Falcons def pass game coordinator 2025) with heavy back-end coverage/blitz disguise; first-time DC. [scheme] offScheme=ProPassing / defScheme=Cover3 are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=Vertical / defSchemeGuess=CoverThree.

DAL.notes: Schottenheimer enters year 2 (7-9-1). Offense intact; defense turned over to Parker (Eagles DBs coach / pass game coordinator 2024-25). Real off scheme: zone-and-gap run game with play-action; Schottenheimer calls the plays, Adams is OC. Real def scheme: Parker brings the Fangio/Eagles two-high nickel. Nick Sorensen is special teams coordinator. [scheme] offScheme=PowerRun / defScheme=Multiple are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WideZone / defSchemeGuess=Nickel. Offense re-graded from the notes: notes say 'zone-and-gap run game' - Schottenheimer's gap-scheme run game is not a wide-zone offense.

Real off scheme: Payton's Saints system (West Coast/Coryell hybrid, heavy play-action); Payton calls the plays. Real def scheme: Vance Joseph's blitz-heavy 3-4 with man coverage. Darren Rizzi is assistant head coach / special teams coordinator. [scheme] offScheme=WestCoast / defScheme=PressMan are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WestCoast / defSchemeGuess=ManPress.

DET.notes: Petzing hired to replace John Morton after a 9-8 2025 (Cardinals OC 2023-25). Real def scheme: Sheppard's Aaron Glenn-tree multiple 4-3 with a high blitz rate. Mike Kafka joined as passing game coordinator after his Giants interim-HC stint. [scheme] offScheme=Shanahan / defScheme=Base43 are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WideZone / defSchemeGuess=43.

[scheme] offScheme=Shanahan / defScheme=Multiple are the Domain/Enums/Scheme.swift raw values; compiled guesses were offSchemeGuess=WideZone / defSchemeGuess=Nickel.

LAC.notes: Both coordinator jobs turned over: McDaniel (fired Dolphins HC 2022-25) takes the offense, O'Leary (Chargers safeties coach 2024, Western Michigan DC 2025) replaces Jesse Minter, who became Ravens HC. Real off scheme: McDaniel's Shanahan-tree outside zone with heavy motion; McDaniel calls the plays - Harbaugh is a 2026 'CEO' head coach. Real def scheme: O'Leary keeps Minter's zone-heavy, communication-driven multiple defense (his stated goal is 'mastery over multiplicity') with a wider DL front. LV.notes: Kubiak confirmed as HC on Feb 8, 2026, immediately after the Seahawks won Super Bowl LX where he was OC; replaced Pete Carroll (fired Jan 5 after a 3-14 season). First HC job. MIA.notes: Hafley hired Jan 19, 2026 after Mike McDaniel was fired Jan 8; Hafley was Packers DC 2024-25 and Boston College HC 2020-23. GM also turned over (Chris Grier out, Jon-Eric Sullivan in). NE.notes: Vrabel's second year after a 14-3 season and Super Bowl LX loss to Seattle. Kuhr promoted from inside linebackers coach - he had called the defense from Week 2 of 2025 onward; Terrell Williams moved to assistant HC. Real def scheme: Vrabel/Kuhr aggressive multiple front built on simulated pressures and line stunts (2nd-highest stunt rate in the NFL in 2025).
